new.text: When it comes to your friends — maybe it's because your friendship is so 【strong】 that they felt able to cancel at late notice.
new.cn: 至于朋友，也许正因为你们的友谊很牢固，他们才觉得临时取消也没关系。

old.text: So keep it simple: "Hi", "Hey"or "Hello" - do the best you can to gather all of the enthusiasm and energy you can, put on a big smile and say "Hi".

new.text: So keep it simple: "Hi", "Hey" or "Hello" - do the best you can to gather all of the enthusiasm and energy you can, put on a big smile and say "Hi".
new.cn: 因此，简单一点就好：“嗨”“你好”都可以；尽量调动热情与精力，露出灿烂的微笑，说声“嗨”。
